# Pro UPI QR - Complete Platform Specification & Developer Knowledge Base

> Pro UPI QR (https://www.proupiqr.in) is a zero-latency, 100% client-side universal UPI (Unified Payments Interface) QR code generator, dynamic link builder, and merchant payment poster generator for Indian bank accounts, shops, freelancers, and businesses.

---

## Key Capabilities & Micro-Tools

### 1. Universal UPI QR Generator
- **URL**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/universal-qr-generator`
- **Description**: Generates NPCI-compliant UPI QR codes compatible with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay, WhatsApp Pay, and all major Indian banking apps.
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% Client-side generation. Zero VPA or payment data sent to backend servers.
- **Export Formats**: Vector SVG, high-resolution PNG, printable PDF standees, sticker sheets.

### 2. Dynamic UPI Link Generator
- **URL**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/upi-link-generator`
- **Description**: Builds deep-link URLs (`upi://pay?pa=...`) that automatically open installed payment apps on mobile devices when clicked.

### 3. Bulk UPI QR Code Generator
- **URL**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/bulk-qr`
- **Description**: Generates multiple custom UPI QR codes simultaneously from uploaded CSV/Excel data with batch ZIP export.

### 4. Digital Visiting Card Builder
- **URL**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/digital-visiting-card`
- **Description**: Creates interactive digital business cards featuring embedded UPI payment QR codes, vCard downloadable contacts, and social media links.

### 5. NPCI Error Code Lookup & Troubleshooting
- **URL**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/upi-error-codes`
- **Description**: Searchable database of NPCI and bank transaction failure codes (e.g. U16, U28, Z9, ZA) with actionable troubleshooting steps.

### 6. Merchant Calculators & Financial Tools
- **GST Payment Calculator**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/gst-calculator`
- **UPI Fee & Settlement Calculator**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/upi-calculator`
- **Profit Margin & Markup Calculator**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/margin-calculator`
- **Bank UPI Transaction Limit Checker**: `https://www.proupiqr.in/upi-limits`

---

## Technical Specifications (UPI URI Schema)

Pro UPI QR construct standard NPCI payment deep links following the official specifications:

```text
upi://pay?pa={VPA}&pn={NAME}&am={AMOUNT}&cu=INR&tn={NOTE}&mc={MCC}&tr={REF_ID}
```

### Parameter Dictionary:
- `pa`: Payee VPA / UPI ID (e.g. `merchant@sbi`, `9876543210@paytm`) [Required]
- `pn`: Payee Display Name (e.g. `Gupta General Store`) [Required]
- `am`: Transaction Amount in INR (e.g. `250.00`) [Optional]
- `cu`: Currency Code (Must be `INR`) [Required]
- `tn`: Transaction Note / Order ID (e.g. `Bill #1042`) [Optional]
- `mc`: Merchant Category Code [Optional]
- `tr`: Transaction Reference ID [Optional]

---

## Bank Compatibility Matrix
Supports all NPCI member banks and third-party apps:
- **Banks**: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra, PNB, Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda, IndusInd, Union Bank, IDFC First Bank, IDBI, YES Bank, RBL, Central Bank.
- **Payment Apps**: PhonePe, Google Pay (GPay), Paytm, BHIM UPI, WhatsApp Pay, Amazon Pay, Navi, CRED, PayZapp.

---

## Developer Embed Widget API

Developers can embed the free UPI QR generator inside any web application:

```html
<iframe src="https://www.proupiqr.in/embed" width="100%" height="480" frameborder="0" style="border:0; border-radius:16px;"></iframe>
<p><a href="https://www.proupiqr.in/">Powered by Pro UPI QR Code Generator</a></p>
```
